verdict.rationale: Meltano documents stream selection, so you can pick individual streams/tables (meltano-docs-10, meltano-docs-19). It also tracks incremental replication state per state ID and runs pipelines via `meltano run` (meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30, meltano-docs-37). These pieces imply a single table could be targeted, but nothing in the pack shows a documented way to reset state, force a full refresh, or backfill history for one stream. Missing for 10: a documented full-refresh/backfill command, per-stream state reset or editing, and hands-on corroboration of resyncing a single table.
